_note: Propulsion subsystem-local dimensions (owner E1). Shared numbers (prop diameter, stations, cant, motor OD, ESC pad, motor face) are read from params/params.json and subsystems/fins/params.json, never copied here. Envelopes of bought parts: every value UNVERIFIED until T-E1-MOTOR-RM measures the first motor, adapter, ESC and prop. Read by fusion/propulsion.py and make_propulsion.py.

body_len_m.note: mount face to bell top; params.json#propulsion.motor_length_m 0.025 is the can only (CR-E1-29)

base_d_m.note: stationary base boss that bears on the canted plate; must cover the 16 x 19 mm screw cross with 5.5 mm heads clear of the bell (measure)

base_h_m.note: base boss height; the bell starts 0.5 mm above it (running gap)

bell_gap_m.note: axial running gap base to bell

shaft_ahead_m.note: overall shaft 33 mm - body 26.5 mm; sits in the adapter's 8.5 mm pilot bore

circlip_d_m.source: E1 EST (DIN 6799 for a 4 mm shaft)
circlip_d_m.note: rear shaft end and E-clip inside the plate's 10 mm square opening (fin_detail.mount.shaft_hole_d_m)

circlip_h_m.note: behind the base face; the plate is 4.5 mm, so the clip never touches the tube

lead_exit_r_m.source: team/F2 wire table W-PH-<st> motor end (y 0.341 at UR)
lead_exit_r_m.note: three factory phase leads leave the base outboard (toward the ESC face of the fin); measure lead length (CR-E1-18)

lead_exit_w_m.source: E1 EST (3 x 16 AWG side by side)

base_d_m.source: E1 EST (4 x M3 on a 12 mm circle + 3 mm wall)

post_len_m.note: above the base; with the 8.89 mm hub and a 1.0 mm washer the ISO 4032 nut (5.2 mm) has 5.31 mm of thread (CL-E1-NUT-ENGAGE)

screw_circle_d_m.note: 4 x M3x4 into the bell top

washer_od_m.source: DIN 988 6 x 12 x 1.0 (supplied with the set)

washer_t_m.note: a 1.6 mm ISO 7089 washer leaves the nut 0.5 mm short of the post tip: do not substitute

bore_d_m.source: APC LPAR06E ring in the 1/4 in bore

pitch_m.note: sets the blade angle beta = atan(p / (2 pi r)) of the envelope only

blade_r_frac.source: E1 EST (APC MR planform from photographs)

blade_chord_m.note: envelope for the CAD and the transport tray, not for aero (B4 uses the PER3 files)

esc._note: ESC envelope = E3's ASM-E3-ESC (45 x 20 x 6 mm in heat-shrink); lies flat on the outboard face of the ASA pad FIN-007, long side along x, FET side out, centred on the pad

size_m.note: x along the fin (slipstream), y away from the pad, z across

spares._note: bought, not flown (not in the mass roll-up); I1 orders them with the flight set
